title: docs: fix man page drift and typos
body:
A batch of small doc fixes, all checked against the vendored sources:

- copy: --dest-compress-format and --dest-compress-level both carried the _format_ placeholder (copy-paste between the entries); they take _FORMAT_ and _LEVEL_.
- list-tags: containers-transports is a section 5 page, not 1.
- login: SEE ALSO pointed at containers-certs.d.5.md (a file name) instead of the containers-certs.d(5) page.
- sync: point the semver comparison examples at the vendored Masterminds/semver v3.5.0 instead of v3.2.0.
- logout: document when --tls-verify actually applies. When the credentials to remove are found in the credentials file, logout only edits the file. Otherwise (e.g. credentials created with docker login) it verifies them against the registry, and --tls-verify applies to that connection. Nothing is removed on that path; use docker logout instead.
- experimental-image-proxy: the protocol version is 0.2.9 (matching vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/json-proxy/types.go), document the OpenVarlinkSocket method, fix GetBlobRaw to GetRawBlob, and the 0.2.5 history entry (GetLayerInfo, not LayerInfoJSON).
- renovate.json5: two comment typos.
